checks.describe: core-internals profile is up and the worker node exists
MCP server Deployment is Running in m10-lab namespace
checks.run: kubectl --context kind-kubeadv-core -n m10-lab get deploy mcp-server -o jsonpath='{.status.readyReplicas}'

checks.describe: ServiceAccount ai-agent exists in m10-lab namespace
checks.run: kubectl --context kind-kubeadv-core -n m10-lab get sa ai-agent -o jsonpath='{.metadata.name}'

checks.describe: ClusterRoleBinding grants ai-agent the read-only ClusterRole
checks.run: kubectl --context kind-kubeadv-core get clusterrolebinding ai-agent-readonly -o jsonpath='{.subjects[0].name}'

checks.describe: MCP tool server accepts read requests (list_pods) — returns 200 with pod data
checks.run: POD=$(kubectl --context kind-kubeadv-core -n m10-lab get pod -l app=mcp-server -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}'); kubectl --context kind-kubeadv-core -n m10-lab exec $POD -- curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"list_pods","arguments":{"namespace":"m10-lab"}}}' | python3 -c 'import sys,json; r=json.load(sys.stdin); print("ok" if not r.get("result",{}).get("isError") else "err")'

checks.describe: MCP tool server denies write requests (create_pod) — RBAC returns 403
checks.run: POD=$(kubectl --context kind-kubeadv-core -n m10-lab get pod -l app=mcp-server -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}'); kubectl --context kind-kubeadv-core -n m10-lab exec $POD -- curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"create_pod","arguments":{"namespace":"m10-lab","name":"rogue","image":"nginx"}}}' | python3 -c 'import sys,json; r=json.load(sys.stdin); print("denied" if r.get("result",{}).get("isError") else "allowed")'

checks.describe: API server audit logging is enabled — audit log file exists on control-plane node
